page.overview:
Who is Conklin?

Captain Conklin was a Starfleet officer in command of the during the mid-24th century.

The Magellan put in at the Federation's Arkaria Base in the late-2360s. While there, the starship's crew put on a talent show at the base, in which Captain Conklin performed a poetry reading. ()
